name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v540: Removed kwik.cx from Cloudflare bypass. kwik.cx stream requests will now fall through to CloudflareKiller instead of the plugin bypass. Note: CloudflareKiller's init calls removeAllCookies(null) which wipes the shared WebView cookie jar, so this may cause AnimePahe cookies to be lost and repeated solves. All v539 fixes retained: 15-second solve cooldown, 30-second poll timeout, visible fallback, always require cf_clearance, removed dead JS cookie probe, clear in-flight bypass on dismiss, background API config load, tightened WebView security, removed double-poll, alpha=0 invisible attach.
